Name: Jahzerah
Summary: Father of Adiel in the Jerusalem priest list, son of Meshullam.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:12: Father of Adiel in the Jerusalem priest list, son of Meshullam.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jahzerah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
